name: EPIC 249612003
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 15, 13.6 solar radii and 1.04 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, EPIC 249612003 (K2 campaign 15): PARAM radius (solar radii) 13.567578 (16th-84th percentiles 12.889864-14.318008), MA09 pipeline with GALAH DR3

text.card: A red giant 1,910 parsecs away, 14 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 15, give 1.04 solar masses and 13.6 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,272 K at its surface.
